description: Timing point 3: each beat is timed at its best-alignment lag against the median of the previous beats, referred to one followed peak of that median beat (no polarity decision), with the HRV cleaning rules. Read by pan_tompkins.py; BeatDetector.kt hard-codes the same values and BeatDetectorConfigTest asserts they match this file. The file keeps its name because the build and the tests refer to it.
tuned_on: Development data: all 48 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia records (all development data from 13 Nov 2026), our recordings dual03, tb01 and tb02, and the BIDMC ECGs for coverage. Settings were frozen as tp3_candidate.json (commit 17128f3) before the held-out run and ported unchanged. The Pan-Tompkins core (thresholds, search-back, refractory, T-wave rule, stall decay) is fixed in code and was not touched.

tp2.1.note: The previous timing point (frozen 2026-10-31, commit da603e2), kept in pan_tompkins.py only, as PanTompkins(fs, timing='tp2.1'), so that results published with it can be reproduced and compared. It uses the detector block's window and template depth and CORR_LAG. The phone no longer runs it.

heldout.tp3: St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database, 75 records from 32 patients, run once on 13 Nov 2026 with these settings (analysis/tp3_incart_heldout.txt). INCART is spent for beat timing.
heldout.tp2.1: The 36 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia records outside the original development subset, run once on 31 Oct 2026 (analysis/heldout_ec57_tp2.1.txt, fiducial_mitdb_heldout32_v3.txt). All 48 MIT-BIH records are development data from 13 Nov 2026.
heldout.next: Our own recordings made after the electrode clips are swapped at bench session 1.
heldout.known_limitation: A beat whose 5-15 Hz peak lands more than CORR_LAG samples (39 ms) from where it usually sits has no correlation maximum inside the search range and is flagged. On INCART patient 24 the peak alternates between two places 41 ms apart, and coverage fell there (analysis/tp3_diagnosis_incart_patient24.txt). Not changed: the cause was found on held-out data.
heldout.rule: no parameter in this file is changed in response to held-out results
